<!-- pr-reviewer: d79ae6dd76bb3e537ab7648da8b15abfb906d8eb -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The change meets issue #1845:
- The four review folders are removed. No tracked file references a removed path.
- The boundary test keeps its structural assertions and removes the capture hook.
- The manual capture test writes to the temporary directory.
- The decision record explains the removal of the PR #1724 evidence. Git history preserves that evidence.

Local verification used `.claude/worktrees/review-1878` at the reviewed head. The trial merge with upstream/main `62e1d36a655a71407ff7a9980057db3c8cc8197a` reported "Already up to date."

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Quick gate plan | Passed; all selected suites ran locally |
| `cargo test -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Passed |
| UI library | 814 passed; 6 ignored |
| `boundary` | 3 passed |
| `boundary_picks` | 6 passed |
| `sinker_setup` | 1 passed |
| `theme_files` | 14 passed |
| xtask unit tests | 136 passed |
| `review_artifacts` | 3 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

UI suites ran from `crates/ui`. Total: 977 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge: none.

This change does not affect posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No goldens changed. Mutation checks were not repeated because this is not a safety-tier change. The UI edits affect test capture helpers only. They do not require before/after screenshots. The ignored manual GPU capture test was not run.

The body contains `Process change: yes`, a `Changelog:` line, and `Fixes #1845`. The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
